question: A list grows from 100 to 1,000 items. About how many steps does a single pass over it take now?
explanation: A single pass does one step per item, so ten times the items means about ten times the steps: about 1,000. That straight-line growth is O(n). If you picked 1,000,000, you were thinking of comparing every item with every other item, which is O(n²).
